Puyallup Trail #248
t.description: Trail #248 begins on Glacier View Trail #267 and proceeds east through a conifer forest to Goat Lake within Glacier View Wilderness. From there it climbs eastward toward the Mt. Rainer National Park boundary and Gobblers Knob.

t.name: Lake Christine Trail #249
t.description: The trail enters a high elevation conifer forest before reaching Lake Christine. From the lake, it continues north through moderately dense forest, ending at Puyallup Trail #248.

t.name: Glacier View Trail #267
t.description: This 3 mile trail provides excellent views of Mt. Rainier and access to a short trail up to the summit of Glacier View. The trail then descends and ends at Lake West.

t.name: Peak Two Trail #268
t.description: The 1.3 mile trail begins in Glacier View Wilderness on Glacier View Trail #267 near Lake West. The trail heads north, leaves the Wilderness, and ends at Lake Helen.
